help.body_1: Open Hustle and serve the corner. Customers text an offer and walk over. Accept, name your own price, or turn them down. Hand it over when they arrive.
help.body_2: Mark a pull-up spot in Hustle and some customers arrive by car. Walk to the window to serve them. They don't wait long.
help.body_3: In a vehicle, take drop-off orders from Hustle. Each order is a door across town. Bigger sales, better money, and the clock is running.
help.body_4: Every sale builds your name in that product. A bigger name brings better prices and new people. They text first. Go and meet them.
help.body_5: Check Turf to see whose ground you're on and what sells there. Sell on a crew's block without paying and they will come and ask.
help.body_6: People talk. A refused pitch or a nosy neighbour can bring the police. Watch your heat in Turf and move on when it climbs.
